description: NHFLOW hydrostatic semi-implicit (A 534 1): 1D tidal channel 20 km, 10 m deep, 3 sigma layers, clamped tidal level (B 520 5, a 0.25 m, T 3 h) at x-, wall at x+, A 536 600 s (the advective limit ~60-80 s sets the step). Over many periods the harmonic amplitude follows the standing-tide solution to 1-2 %.
covers: clamped level edge as eta Dirichlet
